A unit rate gives an amount for one unit. Eighteen dollars for six notebooks means three dollars per notebook.
The word per identifies the denominator. Dollars per kilogram means dollars divided by kilograms. Always label units.
A bus travels 150 kilometers in three hours. Its speed is 150 divided by three, or 50 kilometers per hour.
Rice costs seven dollars and fifty cents for two and a half kilograms. Divide to get three dollars per kilogram.
Nine miles in fifteen minutes is nine miles in a quarter hour, so the speed is thirty-six miles per hour.
Store A costs 0.275 dollars per ounce. Store B costs 0.26 dollars per ounce. Store B is cheaper per ounce.
Do not simply average speeds. Add total distance and total time. Seventy-two kilometers in four hours gives eighteen kilometers per hour.
Identify the units, convert if necessary, divide in the right order, and check your answer. For journeys, divide total distance by total time.
